shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rectangular slab/stele
justification: Both show shallow-relief human figures in profile arranged on an upright slab, but that is about as generic as figural relief gets: A depicts a single large-scale narrative of a horse-drawn chariot with bearded warriors above a field of stylised vegetation/water, while B is a small stele divided into multiple horizontal registers of seated and standing figures interspersed with dense rows of script signs and a winged emblem at the top. Neither the specific motifs (chariot and horse vs. offering-table scenes with inscriptions), the relationships between figures, nor the register-based versus single-scene layout correspond.
